ops.body: - **Back and Escape with the picker's View menu open** (picker media audit 11): the menu is drawn inside the card, so a native Back or Escape closes the whole picker and drops the mark instead of the menu. A Modal's Back can't be taken from JS; the three hosts (`CaptureView`, `NotePage`, `OpenLine`) need a Back protocol the picker can join. Needs the owner's call on the protocol; today the cost is one mark.

- **A stale scroll offset after Months to Days** (picker media audit 12): the list remounts at the landed day, but `offset.current` keeps the old value until a scroll event, so a Zoom In/Out chosen at once anchors from it. Shared by Chronicle's Media and the picker; one fix for both.

- **The viewer's close and More circles over a picker's scrim** (picker media audit 13): the viewer's bars show above the dimming behind Add to a thread and Mention (older than the slice); hide them while an overlay is open, as a tap on a photo does.

- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and an Android phone, in a note, type @, then tap Media with the keyboard up; mark a photo, open View, then press Back (Android) or swipe back. **Expect:** the keyboard goes away on tapping Media so Connect or Mention is never under it; Back with the View menu open closes the picker (the known gap, picker media audit 11) and the note keeps its words (MP2, MP10).

- **The picker's three rows of controls** (picker media audit 14): List | Media, Years | Months | Days with View, and the kind row cost about 170 pt above the grid (two rows of tiles at 320 px). The kind row repeats the View menu's Show. Keep it as built, or move the kind row into View (one row fewer, a kind one tap deeper)? Recommended: keep, until a phone shows it is too tight.
